title: Upsell pathways: Dedicated, Private, Premium SLA playbook
content:
Purpose:
This working playbook captures pragmatic expansion/upsell pathways for Customer Success to drive upgrades from Hosted -> Dedicated, evaluate Private (VPC/on-prem) conversions, and sell premium SLA add-ons. Audience: CSMs, Solutions Engineers, AEs supporting expansion motions.

High-level expansion signals (data + conversation cues):
- Sustained token spend > $12k/month or > 1M tokens/month for 3 consecutive months.
- Repeated rate limit or quota errors reported in support tickets or SLO alerts.
- Latency-sensitive production usage (p99 > 500ms) or CPU/GPU bottlenecks in dedicated trials.
- Security/compliance asks: SOC2, HIPAA, KMS/HSM, VPC peering, data residency request.
- Large dev seat counts, multiple product teams using the account, multiple API keys.
- Upcoming renewal within 90–180 days and total contract value growth opportunity > 25%.
- Feature requests requiring isolation (e.g., private model weights, custom model onboarding).

Pre-qualification checklist (first-touch):
- Confirm billing tier, monthly token run-rate, peak QPS, typical sequence lengths, and model families used.
- Ask about multi-region needs, data classification, and compliance escalations.
- Determine current pain: performance, cost, reliability, or security.
- Identify executive sponsor and technical decision maker.
- Check legal checklist: any active MSA or PO that would speed procurement?

Playbook pathways (recommended cadences):
1) Hosted -> Dedicated (predictable throughput, reduced noisy-neighbor risk)
   - Use case fit: stable production traffic, p99 latency critical, cost predictability required.
   - Business case: show % cost delta at current and projected token volume (model mix + batching).
   - Technical steps: run load profile (QPS, seq len distribution), recommend compute profile (GPU / instance type), brief SRE on autoscale policies and burst capacity.
   - Offer: 3-month commit pilot -> 6/12 month reserved capacity with step-down clauses.
   - Risk mitigation: include fallback to hosted API and bump limits during migration.

2) Hosted/Dedicated -> Private (VPC or on-prem for regulated workloads)
   - Use case fit: regulated industries, strict data residency, air-gapped requirements, or on-prem model hosting.
   - Business case: justify platform fee + onboarding vs internal infra costs. Include compliance cost avoidance (audit overhead).
   - Technical steps: initiate Private intake questionnaire, schedule SC/SE scoping (network topology, Egress rules, KMS), draft timeline (8–12 weeks typical for VPC; 12–20 weeks for on-prem).
   - Procurement: point to enterprise contract templates, support tiers, and optional professional services for deployment.
   - Offer: phased onboarding (pilot in VPC -> full migration), optional white-glove migration package.

3) Premium SLA add-ons (higher availability, accelerated support)
   - Use case fit: mission-critical endpoints, internal SLAs below required thresholds, or business-critical launches.
   - Levers: reduced latency SLOs, higher concurrency, extended retention for logs/traces, priority support (15m/1h response), 24/7 on-call.
   - Pricing approach: additive % on top of usage and reserved commits, or flat monthly for higher-tier support blocks.

Opportunity qualification rubric (quick score 0–10):
- Spend & Growth (0–3): current run-rate + 6mo growth trajectory.
- Technical Risk Pain (0–3): outages, latency, quota issues.
- Compliance/Legal Need (0–2): required private deploy or contractual constraints.
- Deal Complexity & Champion (0–2): procurement difficulty and presence of sponsor.

> Score >=6: engage AE + Solutions Eng immediately. 4–5: nurture with CSM-led ROI and trial. <4: monitor and automated outreach.

QBR/Meeting templates (talking points):
- Opening: metrics overview — token usage, top endpoints, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rates, cost per 1k tokens by model.
- Health: uptime, incidents since last QBR, developer adoption, active API keys.
- Growth: upcoming product launches, forecasted traffic, scale risks.
- Value: cost trends and specific examples of business value delivered.
- Expansion ask: tie recommendation to concrete benefits (e.g., Dedicated -> reduces per-token cost by X% at projected volume; Private -> removes compliance roadblocks enabling launch into EU market).
- Ask: request a technical sync to scope Dedicated sizing or Private intake; propose next steps and timeline.

Email/outreach templates (CSM -> Champion):
- Subject: Quick follow-up on reliability & a proposal to reduce risk
  Hi [Name],
  Noticed sustained growth on your account (avg monthly tokens up ~35%). Based on your p99 latency and the upcoming [product roadmap item], I recommend a short scoping call to evaluate a Dedicated capacity pilot. We can model cost vs performance and outline a 6–8 week pilot. Are you available next week for 30 minutes?

- Subject: Compliance path for [Company] — Private deployment intake
  Hi [Name],
  Thanks for flagging the data residency/controls need. We have a standard Private intake that captures network, KMS, and audit requirements — it typically takes 2–3 calls and a short questionnaire. I can loop in Solutions Eng to scope next steps. When works for you?

Technical gating checklist (SE-led):
- For Dedicated: traffic replay, KV cache behavior, model quantization impact, autoscale thresholds, estimated GPU hours.
- For Private: network diagrams, VPN/VPC peering details, Egress rules, data retention, encryption in transit/at rest, HSM/KMS requirements, compliance evidence requested.

Sample renewal/expansion tracker columns (sheet recommended):
- Account | ARR | Current product tier | Month-to-month run-rate | 90d forecast | Expansion signal date | Primary sponsor | Technical owner | Proposed path | Estimated uplift | Stage | Next action | Owner | Target close

Example row:
- Acme Corp | $180k | Hosted-API | $14k/month | +40% 90d forecast | 2026-01-08 | VP Eng: J. Rogers | SE: Rosa M. | Dedicated pilot -> 12m reserved | +$75k/year | scoping | Asha P. | 2026-03-15

Pricing levers (CS + AE playbook):
- Commit level discounts for 6/12/24 month reserved capacity.
- Volume tiers by token buckets with blended CPM for common model families.
- Migration credits for Private onboarding or discounted professional services for first deployment.
- SLA bundle tiers (silver/gold/platinum) where support response & concurrency guarantees increase with price.

Handoffs & responsibilities:
- CSM: identify signal, own initial outreach, run QBRs, build the business case, maintain rollout timeline.
- SE: technical scoping, capacity estimation, pilot health, migration runbook.
- AE (when engaged): commercial negotiation, contract signatures, and discounts approvals.
- Legal/Procurement: expedite MSA/PO when required.

Common objections + rebuttals:
- "We can stay on hosted and scale." -> "Hosted scales well but we see cost and p99 variances at scale; Dedicated gives predictable throughput and an ops SLA to avoid noisy-neighbor events."
- "Private sounds expensive and slow." -> "We recommend phased approach: VPC pilot first, map to infra costs avoided, and offer migration credits to accelerate ROI."
- "We don’t want long-term commitments." -> "Offer pilot commitments and opt-in step-up discounts; show projected TCO for both month-to-month and reserved scenarios."

Metrics to track for the playbook (CS dashboard ideas):
- Number of qualified expansion opportunities (monthly).
- Time from signal to pilot start.
- Pilot to conversion rate (Dedicated/Private).
- Average uplift ARR per conversion.
- SLA upsell attach rate.

Notes / open questions for the team:
- Create a standard cost-model spreadsheet CSMs can edit per-account: inputs = current model mix, seq length distribution, batch rate, desired p99; outputs = projected cost delta and GPU sizing.
- Build a templated Private intake questionnaire (network + security) in Confluence.
- Coordinate with Product for guardrails on fallback policies between Dedicated/Hosted during migrations.

Next steps (action items):
- Asha: draft the cost-model template by 2025-11-10.
- Rosa: prototype Private intake questionnaire and share by 2025-11-17.
- Daniel: wire AE discount bands into a one-pager for CSM/AEs by 2025-11-20.

Appendix: sample short ROI narrative (one-liner for deals)
- "Moving Acme from Hosted to Dedicated will reduce p99 variability, cut per-token cost by ~18% at projected volumes, and remove a deployment blocker for their EU launch — enabling a $1.2M ARR opportunity to ship on schedule."

End of working draft. Still needs: templated spreadsheets, Private intake page, and pricing bands finalized with finance.
